items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy Thanksgiving geography fun-fact Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how funny this mix-up is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. The country-by-country names (France, Portugal, Arabic, Malaysia) are a rapid, giggly list, each one funnier than the last. 'And it gets even weirder' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. Mexico's line is a cheeky, slightly offended little voice-wink. The last line trails off unfinished, voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy, about 175 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Numbers and English words (country names, bird, turkey, guinea fowl, African, Turkish, confuse, UN, Thursday, Roman, Dutch) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. Numbers are always read in English, clearly. Pronounce Türkiye as tur-kee-YAY, guajolote as gwah-ho-LOH-teh, dinde as DAND (French), peru as peh-ROO, Aztecs as AZ-teks, guinea fowl as GIH-nee fowl. The word Hindi (the Turkish name for the bird) is said like the language name, HIN-dee, with a big surprised emphasis. turki is said TUR-kee.
lines: एक bird जिसका नाम एक देश पर है... जहां का वो है ही नहीं।
असल में ये Mexico का है। Aztecs इसे पालते थे two thousand साल से भी पहले।
Fifteen hundreds में Spanish इन्हें ले गए Europe.
लेकिन Europe confuse हो गया। ये दिखता था guinea fowl जैसा... एक African bird जो आया था Turkish इलाकों से होकर।
तो English वालों ने नाम रख दिया... turkey.
लेकिन Turkey में इसे क्या कहते हैं?
और India में? Hindi में इसे कहते हैं... turki!
और ये तो और भी अजीब है।
Portugal: peru... Peru देश के नाम पर!
हर देश ने इसका नाम किसी और देश पर रखा।
Twenty twenty-two में Turkey ने UN से कहा: Türkiye बोलो... थोड़ा इस bird से पीछा छुड़ाने को।
और Mexico? भाई... ये मेरा है। हम इसे guajolote कहते हैं!
तो इस Thursday... आप खा रहे होंगे...
